title: The Big Travel Plan
setting: A bright living room in a British house with a large world map on the wall.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots)

sentences.en: Ben and Lily are children in Britain.
sentences.zh: 本和莉莉是住在英国的孩子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) stand in front of a red-brick British house with a small British flag by the door.

sentences.en: They look at a big map of the world.
sentences.zh: 他们看着一张大大的世界地图。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) look at a large world map without any writing on the living room wall.

sentences.en: They put clothes in a big bag to travel.
sentences.zh: 他们把衣服放进一个大包里，准备去旅行。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) put clothes into a big open travel bag on the floor in front of the world map.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the children filling a travel bag by the map; the plan to travel can only be guessed.

sentences.en: Ben points at Japan and Sweden on the map.
sentences.zh: 本指着地图上的日本和瑞典。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) pins a small Japanese flag on Japan and a small Swedish flag on Sweden on the world map.

sentences.en: Lily points at Italy, Portugal and Switzerland.
sentences.zh: 莉莉指着意大利、葡萄牙和瑞士。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) points at Italy, Portugal and Switzerland on the world map, each marked with a small flag of that country.

sentences.en: Lily is a little afraid of flying.
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) looks worried and holds a toy plane away from her, next to Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts).
sentences.draw_note: Shows Lily looking scared at a toy plane; 'a little' and the idea of flying are only suggested.

sentences.en: Their first trip goes west across England by car.
sentences.zh: 他们的第一次旅行是坐车向西穿过英格兰。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small car drives along a green English country road toward the setting sun, Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) waving from the back window.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the car driving toward the setting sun on an English road; 'first' and 'west' are only suggested.

sentences.en: A friendly driver smiles at them in the car.
sentences.zh: 一位友好的司机在车里冲他们微笑。
sentences.scene_prompt: A friendly driver turns and smiles at Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) in the back seat of a car on a country road.
